parameters.hbm_timing_scope: standard reference; timing packs only support 32Gb x 16H and are not applied to this 24Gb x 8H organization

hbf_parameters.geometry_basis: FlashLabAE 16 channels * 1 die/channel * 16 banks/die; target and LUN are singleton mapping levels
hbf_parameters.timing_basis: 4 us read, 75 us program and 2 ms erase are upstream exploratory assumptions, not OCP mandated latencies
hbf_parameters.queue_basis: 256 combined requests and 64 writes per host channel are local research assumptions; not a measured MOCS or an exact copy of upstream read/write queues

parameters.ttft_definition: arrival to first committed output token
parameters.tpot_definition: (last output token time - first output token time) / (output_tokens - 1)

manifest.ttft_definition: request arrival to first visible output token
manifest.tpot_definition: (last visible token time - first visible token time) / (output_tokens - 1)

architecture_evidence.notes: Layer counts and tensor dimensions are grounded in the official config at the pinned commit; no separate official architecture diagram is asserted by this catalog entry.
architecture_evidence.uncertainty: Architecture graph is generated from config fields, not a manually traced paper figure.

metadata.notes: Public config.json fields; bf16 storage bytes are derived analytically.

model_assumptions: ordinary single-request Decode with fixed resident weights and dense attention
steady mean Token cost lies in a nonnegative affine context-growth envelope
ordinary OCP page-zero erases are bounded by serial service budgets; GC and block reuse remain excluded
after observed ordinary erases, a new steady-cost fit may exclude those already timed prefix cohorts and their cleanup; future erase guards remain unchanged
no unseen cache, scheduling, pressure-flush or allocation regime change
per-storage conditional timing bounds are tightened to target/(2+target) for the storage ratio
prefix holdout error does not establish full-suffix accuracy

semantic_reuse_review.reason: 7B has untied weights and HBM skips HBF initialization; physical path unchanged
